Why DegreeSteps is free

DegreeSteps is free.

You can build, save and compare degree plans without paying anything.

Referral fees, always labelled

In the future, DegreeSteps may earn a referral fee from some course providers or schools when someone follows a link and signs up. Any link that can earn us a fee is labelled “Partner link” and points back to this page.

We do not have any referral partners today.

What a fee never changes

A referral fee never changes which plans, schools or courses you see, or the order they appear in. Plans and rankings are worked out the same way whether or not a provider or school is a partner.

Where plans come from

Plans are built from schools’ published sources, such as catalogs, transfer guides and credit policies, and each plan links to them. Your school makes the final decisions about credit and degree requirements.
